_about: Every official 'Item Filter Information' post GGG has made, from the Announcements forum (forum 54). Found via https://www.pathofexile.com/search/results/filter+information/search-within/threads/forums/54 — pages 1-6; page 6 held none, so this is the tail.
_join: Thread titles are MARKETING names and do not match league names, so version comes from matching the thread's post date against docs/league_timeline.csv (the post lands a few days before the league's release date).

_note_on_extracted: true = its events are in timeline.json. 'partial' = captured as a summary, not verbatim, so its lists may be incomplete. false = indexed but not yet read. The recent window is what decides CURRENT status, and our base data comes from the 3.29 GGPK dump anyway, so anything retired long ago is already absent from BaseItemTypes — the older posts matter mainly for RENAMES and RETURNS.
